        <script><![CDATA[class StudioUtils {
    static type = "StudioUtils";
    static STUDIO_HOMEPAGE = "/now/servicenow-studio";
    /**
     * Returns AppDetails Page URL
     * @param {String} appSysID
     * @returns {String}
     */
    static getAppDetailsPageURL(appSysID) {
        const gr = new GlideRecord('sys_scope');
        let className = '';
        if (gr.get(appSysID))
            className = gr.getValue('sys_class_name');
        else
            throw "Please provide valid application sysId.";
        return `/now/servicenow-studio/builder?table=${className}&sysId=${appSysID}`;
    }
}]]></script>
